issue_request: FHIR-48681 was an Applied/Persuasive Security WG change request for R6 asking to add AuditEvent.entity.description, especially for audits of searches and compatibility with DICOM AuditMessage ParticipantObjectDescription.

additional_context: AuditEvent is active in source/fhir.ini. FHIR-20888 previously removed the same element for R5, but FHIR-48681 is the later Applied decision to reintroduce it. FHIR-53184 later touches the AuditEvent-entity-desc search parameter status as part of a broad AuditEvent checklist and was not decided here.
reconciliation: No source changes were made because source/auditevent/structuredefinition-AuditEvent.xml already defines AuditEvent.entity.description as a 0..1 string with DICOM ParticipantObjectDescription mapping, and source/auditevent/bundle-AuditEvent-search-params.xml already defines AuditEvent-entity-desc with expression AuditEvent.entity.description.
